capabilities: Set top scroll padding in vh with a slider
Auto-calculate bottom scroll padding (100 minus top)
Keep the active line at a preferred vertical position while typing
extras: README explicitly states the plugin provides only this single function (dynamic scroll padding via slider) and does not offer typewriter features beyond it.
problem: Obsidian's editor offers no built-in way to keep the cursor line centered or at a preferred vertical spot while typing long documents.
summary: Typewriter-mode plugin that keeps the active editor line at a fixed vertical position via adjustable top and bottom scroll padding.
